metadata.description: Limousine service in Prague: a Mercedes S-Class with a professional chauffeur for airport arrivals, weddings, business days and VIP evenings. Available 24/7.

hero.label: Limousine · Prague
hero.intro: Book a limousine in Prague the way executives and diplomats travel: a Mercedes-Benz S-Class with a professional chauffeur, for an airport arrival, a wedding, a day of meetings or an evening at the opera. Fixed price before you book, from €{sClassAirport} for an airport transfer or €{hourlyS} per hour.
hero.imageAlt: Rear cabin of a Mercedes-Benz S-Class limousine with leather seats

items.label: The car
items.value: Mercedes-Benz S-Class, 2025 model year or newer

items.label: Capacity
items.value: Up to 3 passengers, 2 large cases + 2 cabin bags

items.label: Airport
items.value: From €{sClassAirport}, meet and greet with a name board

paragraphs: In Prague, “limousine” can mean two very different things. One is the stretch limo or party Hummer — long, loud and built for a night out. The other is the executive limousine: the Mercedes-Benz S-Class, the car embassies, heads of state and five-star hotels use to move their guests.

Prestigo is the second kind. We do not operate stretch limousines or party buses. Every limousine booking is a black S-Class with a chauffeur in a suit, a quiet cabin and a fixed price agreed before the trip.
If your group is larger than three, the same service runs in a Mercedes V-Class for up to six passengers, or in several cars that travel together.

items.title: Airport limousine
items.body: Your chauffeur tracks the flight, waits in the arrivals hall with a name board and includes 60 minutes of free waiting. From €{sClassAirport} to anywhere in Prague.

items.title: Wedding limousine
items.body: A clean black S-Class for the couple, on time to the minute. The chauffeur waits during the ceremony and the photographs, then takes you on to the reception.

items.title: Business and roadshows
items.body: A car waiting outside every meeting, Wi-Fi on board and a chauffeur who keeps the schedule. Monthly invoicing is available for companies.

items.title: Evenings out
items.body: Dinner, the opera or the National Theatre without thinking about parking or taxis. Hourly hire from €{hourlyS} per hour with a 2-hour minimum.

items.title: VIP and delegations
items.body: Discreet chauffeurs, privacy glass and several cars coordinated for one programme — for delegations, artists and private clients.

items.title: Intercity by limousine
items.body: Vienna, Munich, Berlin or Budapest in an S-Class, door to door, with tolls and vignettes included in the fixed price.

steps.label: How it works
steps.heading: Booking a limousine in four steps.

items.title: Choose the S-Class
items.body: Enter the pickup, destination and time, then choose First Class — the Mercedes S-Class. You see the full price before paying.

items.title: Add the details
items.body: Flight number, name for the board, child seats, a stop on the way or a dress code for the chauffeur.

items.title: Meet your chauffeur
items.body: You receive the chauffeur’s name and phone number in advance. They arrive early and wait at the agreed place.

items.title: Ride in quiet
items.body: Massage seats, water on board and a calm cabin. Extra stops or extra time can be arranged with the chauffeur on the day.

editorial.label: Why the S-Class
paragraphs: What makes a car a limousine is not how long it is but how it feels inside. The S-Class has rear massage seats, Nappa leather, ambient lighting and a panoramic roof, with privacy glass and enough legroom to work or sleep after a long-haul flight.

It is also a car that fits Prague. A stretch limousine cannot turn in the lanes of the Old Town or stop outside most hotels; an S-Class can go wherever a normal car goes, and the chauffeur knows where it may wait.
Every chauffeur speaks English, with Russian, German or Czech on request. Bottled water, Wi-Fi and charging are always on board; child seats are free on request.

faqs.q: How much does a limousine in Prague cost?
faqs.a: An S-Class airport transfer to Prague starts at €{sClassAirport}. Hourly limousine hire starts at €{hourlyS} per hour with a 2-hour minimum. The price is fixed when you book; there is no meter.

faqs.q: Do you have stretch limousines or Hummer limousines?
faqs.a: No. Prestigo operates executive limousines only — the Mercedes-Benz S-Class — plus the E-Class and the V-Class for groups. We do not run stretch limos or party buses.

faqs.q: Can I book a limousine for a wedding in Prague?
faqs.a: Yes. The chauffeur arrives early, waits during the ceremony and photographs and drives the couple to the reception. For guests, add a V-Class or several cars.

faqs.q: How many people fit in the limousine?
faqs.a: The S-Class takes up to 3 passengers with 2 large cases and 2 cabin bags. For up to 6 passengers, book a Mercedes V-Class.

faqs.q: Can the limousine meet me at Prague Airport?
faqs.a: Yes. The chauffeur tracks your flight, waits in the arrivals hall with a name board and includes 60 minutes of free waiting after landing.

faqs.q: How far in advance should I book?
faqs.a: Book online at least 12 hours ahead. For shorter notice, call +420 725 986 855 — we operate 24/7.
